items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 27 July 2026 10:49pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Monday, 27 July 2026 at 10:45pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong Wind Warning for later on Tuesday.


##Synopsis##

Shallow area of low pressure near Iceland, weak warm front affecting the area.


##Wind##

Southwest 3 or 4, increasing 4 or 5 later in the night or Tuesday morning, then 5 or 6 in the evening.


##State of Sea##

Slight, soon becoming slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Patchy outbreaks of light rain or drizzle, becoming mainly fair tomorrow morning.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in rain or drizzle.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Southwest 5 or 6, imminently decreasing 4 or 5, then soon 3 or 4, veering mainly west late on Wednesday.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, soon becoming slight on Wednesday morning.


##Weather##

Mainly fair, then outbreaks of rain later.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate later.
